title: Clean Tickets, Wrong Orders: Catching Silent Errors with a Language Model in Your Browser Tab
abstract: arXiv:2611.18284v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A small language model that turns a typed order into structure can fail in two ways. It can print something broken, which any system rejects. Or it can print a clean, well formed order that nobody placed. Our companion work calls the second kind a silent error, and it is the dangerous one. We present a web demo in which a fine-tuned 0.8B parameter model runs entirely inside the visitor's browser tab, through llama.cpp compiled to WebAssembly. No order text leaves the device. The page parses orders as the visitor types, scores every ticket with the PIZZA benchmark's own matcher ported to TypeScript, refuses anything off the menu with "?" so the model can face the open web, and lets visitors hunt for silent errors or try to cause one. Run in the browser on all 1,357 PIZZA test orders, the deployed model writes the same output as the server evaluation for 99.0% of them and reaches the same exact match (0.882); we also report its latency o

translated_title: 清洁票据，错误订单：用浏览器标签页中的语言模型捕捉静默错误
translated_abstract: 将输入订单转换为结构化数据的小型语言模型可能以两种方式失败：一是输出损坏的内容，任何系统都会将其拒绝；二是输出一个干净、格式良好却无人真正下过的订单。我们的配套工作将第二种情况称为“静默错误”，而这才是危险的一种。我们展示了一个网页演示：一个经过微调的0.8B参数模型通过编译为WebAssembly的llama.cpp完全在访问者的浏览器标签页中运行，任何订单文本都不会离开用户设备。页面在访问者输入时实时解析订单，使用移植到TypeScript的PIZZA基准测试自带匹配器对每张票据进行评分，用"？"拒绝任何不在菜单上的内容以让模型直面开放网络，并允许访问者寻找静默错误或尝试制造一个。在浏览器中对全部1,357个PIZZA测试订单运行时，该部署模型对99.0%的订单输出与服务器端评估完全一致，并达到相同的精确匹配率（0.882）；我们还报告了其延迟表现。
tldr: 本文展示了一个完全在浏览器本地运行的小型语言模型演示系统，利用移植到TypeScript的PIZZA匹配器实时捕捉“静默错误”（即模型生成格式正确却无人真正下过的订单），其表现与服务器端评估几乎完全一致。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a web demo where a fine-tuned 0.8B language model runs entirely locally in the browser via WebAssembly, using a TypeScript port of the PIZZA matcher to catch "silent errors"—well-formed orders nobody actually placed—with performance matching server-side evaluation.
